steps.note: Observe the current screen to locate a file manager app
Launch the Files app and inspect its screen
Open the roots drawer and select the sdk_gphone_x86_64 storage root
Read the roots list items in the drawer
Open the sdk_gphone64_x86_64 root and find the Podcasts folder
Read the contents of the sdk_gphone64_x86_64 storage root
Open the Podcasts folder and locate 2023_09_01_strong_dog.mp3
Long press 2023_09_01_strong_dog.mp3 to select it and reveal the delete option

Confirm deletion with OK and verify the file no longer appears in Podcasts
Task complete; file deleted and verified absent
